text:
maria.g: quick RFC follow-up  i prototyped a small 'artifact' event that we can emit when low-bit quant paths show quality drift. want a fast sanity check before i open the PR.

samir: thanks. top-level Q: do we tie artifacts to profile only or to (model,profile,route)?

maria.g: (model,profile,route). we need route to map to customer behavior.

li: nit: use snake_case for fields, add event_id and profile_version. add severity_bucket {low,medium,high} for dashboards.

aj: ops ask: include a compact JSON example + a prometheus-friendly label set so we can emit metrics without parsing the whole blob.

maria.g: example payload (redacted) i used in demo:

```
model=redwood-v2-medium
profile_id=fp8-aggressive-2026-10
profile_version=4
route=/chat/generate
event_id=evt-20261002-42
severity_bucket=high
degrade_score=0.82
fidelity_budget=0.12
quality_anchor=qa_taskset_v2
anchor_examples=[weather_brief, task_extract_long]
token_index=19
residual_norm=0.041
kv_mismatch=false
sample_output_snippet="[redacted] lost date specificity"
redaction_performed=true
metadata_ttl_seconds=1209600
sample_ttl_seconds=604800
explainability_collected=false
explainability_uri=gs://redwood-quant/explain/2026/evt-20261002-42
collect_cost_ms=0.5
collect_size_bytes=20480
customer_tier=premium
canary_flag=true
```

jenna: metrics to export: quant_artifact_count, quant_degrade_p50, quant_degrade_p95, quant_anchor_regressions, quant_residual_norm_avg. include labels: model, profile_id, route, severity_bucket, customer_tier, canary_flag.

samir: heavy Q: do we ever collect token-level deltas / saliency? very useful for debugging but expensive and potentially sensitive.

maria.g: gated opt-in. default explainability_collected=false. for canaries or signed customers we collect and store explainability artifacts behind admin-only ACL. I'll add a short microbenchmark note in the doc: collection overhead ~0.5ms p99 and ~20kb per collected artifact.

aj: ops requirement: sample_output_snippet MUST be redacted before storage. we need a redaction pipeline stage and two-tier TTLs (metadata vs sample). also record redaction_reason when applied.

li: add artifact_resolution event type so we can close the loop. resolution_reason enum = {rollout_rollback, profile_tweak, false_positive, noop}. include resolver_name and resolution_notes.

maria.g: agreed. plan: emit artifact_event and artifact_resolution events to telemetry pipeline. include a small backfill job to tag historical events with profile_version when missing.

dena: product ask: include estimated chargeback fields (estimated_cost_ms, storage_bytes) so finance can model costs per tenant.

maria.g: added collect_cost_ms and collect_size_bytes in payload. will also output a compact prometheus label set for each event so metrics are cheap.

aj: sample alert sketch for oncall: 
```
WHEN quant_degrade_p95 > 0.75 for 10m
THEN page oncall -> include top anchor_examples + minimal diff view
AUTOMATION: add profile to shadow_sampling for 1h and increase sampling rate for canary customers
```

li: also require admin scope for explainability retrieval, and audit-log any retrievals.

maria.g: will add admin-only retrieval, audit events, and a config flag to enable explainability collection per-customer. default: off. I'll open PR with schema (snake_case), console mockups (diff view + artifact timeline), a tiny backend shim to emit events, and the ops runbook (redaction, TTLs, admin retrieval). tagging reviewers. :pray: 

ops-bot: /observe quant-artifacts --since 24h --profile fp8-aggressive --group-by route,model

ops-bot: maria.g mentioned samir, aj, li, jenna, dena in #eng-ml
